ADAPTED IMPLEMENTATION

Playground JSON/protobuf field mappings, Google session signatures, WAA challenge
decoding, experiments-state handling and lifecycle calls in backend/pgproxy/waa.py,
playground_protocol.py, playground_client.py and session.py include adaptations
of the AIStudio2API implementation:
https://github.com/Mag1cFall/AIStudio2API
Reference revision: 7cb5cc04676751b588146052475deec147fee35e
Copyright (c) 2026 Mag1cFall
Licensed under MIT; see THIRD_PARTY_LICENSE_AIStudio2API.txt.

runtime/waa is adapted from internal/waa of that same AIStudio2API revision,
including its Firefox JavaScript host. This is adapted implementation code,
not merely a design reference. runtime/main.go provides the local pipe adapter.
PG Proxy does not run, require, or connect to an AIStudio2API backend service.
The helper has no HTTP listener; Python manages accounts, requests and streaming.
runtime/vendor contains the Goja fork and other dependencies with their original
licenses. Preserve all vendor license, copyright and attribution files.

RUNTIME AND INTERFACE COMPONENTS

AndroidX/Compose, Chaquopy, CPython, FastAPI, Uvicorn, HTTPX, Pydantic, Go, Rust
and their dependencies retain their respective licenses. See requirements-lock.txt,
runtime/go.mod, runtime/vendor and app/src/main/assets/third_party. Python wheel
license metadata is retained in the application packages. Do not treat all
dependencies as MIT; for example, certifi is covered by MPL 2.0.

The login browser uses unmodified Mozilla GeckoView under MPL 2.0 and its bundled
third-party licenses. The exact source revision, corresponding-source URL and
complete notices are in app/src/main/assets/third_party/gecko. PG Proxy's Kotlin
integration and session-bridge extension do not modify Mozilla engine sources.

DESIGN AND PUBLIC NETWORK SERVICES

Interface information hierarchy and card styling, and public IP lookup services,
were researched in FlClash: https://github.com/chen08209/FlClash
Reference revision: 7fd417fb9a9a277c6a9339a8ac87f907df7c25f7
Reference files: lib/common/service_probe.dart, lib/common/ip_quality.dart,
lib/models/common.dart, lib/models/ip_quality.dart and the dashboard widgets.
PG Proxy's Compose interface and Python lookup client are independently
implemented; no FlClash source code or assets are bundled. Service URLs and
data semantics are documented in docs/NETWORK_INFO.md.

ICON AND TRADEMARKS

The launcher icon was redrawn as an Android vector, using a Labs-inspired flask
from a user-provided visual reference and a Gemini star outline from the
user-provided google-gemini.svg. The star is now a transparent cutout.
An independent license for the supplied reference artwork was not verified.
Do not infer a Google trademark or logo permission from this project's MIT
license. Google, Google Labs, Gemini, Mozilla and Firefox names and marks remain
the property of their respective owners. PG Proxy is not an official Google
or Mozilla product and is not endorsed by them.
